messages:
chandra: quick flag — packaging discovered the cosign key used to sign the airgap manifest for 2026-02 has a notAfter in 4 days. our private/vpc onprem cutover is scheduled 3 days from now at 04:00 UTC.
elaine: ack. is the key in KMS or local signer?
matt: @chandra do we know if the installer validation will fail hard on clients that fetch the signed manifest after expiry?
chandra: key is in KMS; signer rotates keys but archive still has the old cert footprint. installer bootstrap does a cosign verify against manifest sig -> it will fail if cert chain invalid.
jess: that sounds like a hard failure for new installs. existing installs won't re-verify unless they re-bootstrap. we need new signed artifacts pushed to airgap mirrors.
chandra: proposal: 1) re-sign manifest with new KMS key, 2) republish sealed bundle with a new epoch tag (epoch+1), 3) keep current numeric image tags pinned for 48h to avoid client drift, 4) deploy-bot can run a canary cutover for 20 hosts then full push.
elaine: 👍 + please add a changelog entry and set the installer semantic version bump to patch. also we need to update the shipper manifest hash and the shrinkwrap lock.
matt: what are rollback criteria? need to be explicit for ops.
chandra: rollback triggers: a) canary hosts fail cosign verify b) installer bootstrap returns non-zero preflight on >10% of canary hosts c) manifest hash mismatch between mirror and consumer nodes after propagation (>5 minute tail latency) d) unexpected 5xx from staging registries.
jess: add e) if deploy-bot reports stuck state or >30% upload retries in 15m.
packer-bot: packaging checklist executed: [artifact build OK, checksums OK, cosign verify (old) OK] — re-sign step pending.
elaine: schedule suggestion: perform re-sign and republish at T-48h window (i.e., 2 days before cutover) during low traffic (01:00–03:00 UTC) so mirrors can sync. run a smoke job against 3 mirrored sites.
matt: ops note: during re-sign we must not rotate the image tags clients are pinned to. create new epoch manifest but keep the image tag map consistent. patch release notes should call out 'manifest re-sign for cert rotation' and include the new epoch hash.
chandra: deploy-bot: can you reserve a canary window for 04:30 UTC on cutover day for 20 hosts and provide preflight/fallback commands?
deploy-bot: @chandra reserved canary window 3098790000 — run `/deploy private-epoch-canary --count=20 --manifest=epoch-2026-02-v2` to start. Fallback: `/deploy abort private-epoch-canary` then `/deploy rollback-manifest --manifest=epoch-2026-02-v1` if requested. Will emit status updates to this channel.
jess: manual ops steps for cutover: 1) announce freeze (no other packaging edits) 30m prior, 2) run deploy-bot canary, 3) monitor cosign verification logs: `grep cosign /var/log/installer-bootstrap.log | tail -n 200` 4) run smoke script on 20 canary hosts, 5) if clean for 15m, promote to full push.
elaine: KMS handoff: I'll rotate the signing key and publish the new public cert to the keyring. @matt you'll push the sealed bundle. @jess you'll run the smoke and watch installer logs. chandra you'll verify the manifest hashes.
matt: ack. I'll build sealed bundle with tag `sealed-offline-epoch-2026-02-v2` and upload to staging mirror. will include cosign annotation: `cosign.sigstore.version=1.5` and `release.epoch=v2`.
packer-bot: note: when republishing, checksum TTL needs bump to 72h to allow mirrors to fully sync.
chandra: quick checklist for rollback decision: 1) if any host fails preflight with cosign error -> abort 2) if mirror divergence > 5 minutes -> abort 3) >5% failure after promotion -> consider hot rollback.
jess: I'll prepare the `hot-rollback.sh` which calls `/deploy rollback-manifest` and recreates previous signed symlink.
matt: release notes snippet ready, I'll drop in the console release page after republish.
elaine: after republish, we should run an out-of-band verifier against each mirror: `curl <mirror>/manifest.sha256 | sha256sum -c -` — confirm all mirrors match before scheduling canary.
chandra: timeline summary: T-48h re-sign + republish (01:00–03:00 UTC), mirror sync + verifiers T-47h, documentation/update console T-46h, freeze 30m before cutover, canary 04:30 UTC, full push 05:15 UTC if canary clean.
jess: reminder: document rollback contact list in release notes: pager oncall (matt), packaging lead (chandra), ops lead (elaine).
elaine: I'll add the emergency backout runbook to the console and tag the customer delivery ticket.
chandra: ok team — I'll start KMS rotate and request cosign signing policy update. ping here when the new public cert is in the keyring and I'll start republish.
packer-bot: packaging pipeline triggered: `re-sign-request` job queued.
deploy-bot: will watch for `sealed-offline-epoch-2026-02-v2` in staging and will auto-announce when canary window opens.
jess: thanks. I'll be online for the window and will post logs here. :thumbsup:
